text_block_list.text:
Past curfew, the grounds were completely silent.
On my way to the trainer's room to grab something I'd forgotten—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look who it is, Trainer-chan!
What a coincidence♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We, you see~
came here to see a ghost!☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"We were watching a ghost story show on TV,
and started talking about how the Academy has ghost stories too, so—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I-It's obviously a lie anyway,
but Mayano just wouldn't listen~...
choice_data_list: We're past curfew, I need to get home.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "R-R-Right on, right?! We've checked out everywhere interesting, and I'm bored now!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? Then just one more place~!
Maya wants to go to the Trainer's room!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Once upon a time, there was an Umamusume who died
in an accident the day before her Racewear arrived...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Her ghost appears in the Trainer's Room at night.
Crying, 'Where is my racing outfit~...?!'"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ummm~...
T-That's gotta be a made-up story for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but I don't get it at all!
Trainer-chan, please take me there~!

Giving in to Mayano Top Gun, who refused to budge an inch,
the three of us headed to the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Mr. Ghost~!
Where aaare you~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you have to go and call it out?!
What're we gonna do if it actually shows up?!

"A wandering ghost in search of the racing silks
she never once had the chance to wear, huh..."
choice_data_list: That ghost must have had lingering regrets.
That ghost must have felt so full of regret, huh?

text_block_list.text:
"A wandering ghost in search of the racing silks
she never once had the chance to wear, huh..."
choice_data_list: That ghost must have had lingering regrets.
That ghost must have felt so full of regret, huh?

text_block_list.text:
When I told her that she surely must have wanted
to run on the turf in her racing silks—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right?
She must've truly loved running...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even if Maya was that kid,
Maya'd be so lonely and frustrated that Maya'd come here too!
choice_data_list: I'd love to help them avenge their regrets.
I want to help settle that score for them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I know! Maya will run for the ghost's sake, too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the ghost who can't race,
I'm gonna do super well in tons of races!♪"
(Rattle, rattle)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!?
The window opened all of a sudden!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! I hate this, let's go home!
What're we gonna do if we get possessed?!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Becoming friends with a ghost
sounds pretty fun to me, though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Mr. Ghost☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Maya will do her very best, Ghost-san!

Mayano Top Gun's running was light and brisk,
as if carried by a tailwind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaa!!
A ghooooost~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!!
He~lp meee~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

I chased after Tokai Teio in a panic,
but completely lost sight of her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Teio-chan,
you really were scared of ghosts after all...
choice_data_list: Where did they go, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm... We're at least not gonna go through any dark, scary places, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Then the answer is simple!
Let's go!"

Following Mayano Top Gun, who claimed to know
the route Tokai Teio was taking—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Found you, Teio-chan!!

Accompanied by an unusually silent Tokai Teio,
the three of us decided to head home.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*.
'Mornin', Trainer-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we didn't get to see any ghosts yesterday~
Booooring.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, that's totally fine!
Jeez, you had me worried, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't come back to the room,
and she isn't answering my calls either!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Teio-chan,
didn't you head home with Maya and the others?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I went home by myself, though.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Then what about Teio-chan,
who was with Maya and the others—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh!?
